consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 5/26/95 show at Seattle Center was one of the best performances of the year, showcasing Jerry Garcia's creativity and energy. The standout moments included unique interpretations of classic songs, particularly during the 'Scarlet>Fire' sequence, which many reviewers found to be exceptional.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 54 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the performance and energy of the show, there were notable criticisms regarding sound quality and some inconsistencies in the band's execution, leading to a more tempered overall sentiment.
